A place to catch what would otherwise vanish.

Inner Thought exists to help people catch their creativity before it disappears—and to do so with privacy, dignity, and grace. Speak it, type it, photograph it, or film it. Organize it later, or not at all.
Ready when thought arrives. Quiet when it doesn’t.
The thought does not need to be ready.
A title can wait. A category can wait. The idea cannot. Inner Thought shortens the distance between the moment something arrives and the moment it is safe.
Keep the original recording and, when you choose, its complete transcript.
Dictate without keeping audio, or simply type what came to you.
Add a one-time location only when that context belongs to the thought.
Hold photographs and video privately inside the memory.

Accessibility is part of whether the promise is true—not a separate edition and not a final polish pass. Every common task is being designed and tested across different ways of seeing, hearing, moving, reading, and interacting.
VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, Larger Text, Reduce Motion, contrast, keyboard access, and clear non-audio state are release requirements.
Your thoughts are not the product.

Inner Thought requires no account and contains no in-app advertising or third-party analytics. Saved titles, words, locations, custom tags, recordings, photos, and videos are encrypted on your device with a key held by iOS Keychain.
On-device transcription; no transcript content in widgets or logs by default.
No subscription beside your private thoughts.
May this app help people capture their own creativity.
May it be beautiful, helpful, fruitful, and useful.
May it reach the people whose thoughts need somewhere to land.
Your inner world deserves both beauty and clarity. Read the full privacy promise, find help, or reach a real person whenever you need us.

Your thoughts are not the product. Inner Thought is built to keep the inner world you capture under your control.
no account, no advertising, no third-party analytics, no sale of data, and no cloud service operated by Moving Truth.
Only what you choose to create: titles, typed or dictated text, voice recordings, optional one-time locations, tags, photos, videos, favorites, and the dates needed to organize or recover a thought.
Location is never a movement history. Inner Thought requests one location fix for a thought only when you have enabled location for that capture.

Saved titles, transcripts, location details, custom tag names, recording references, media descriptions, audio, photos, and videos are encrypted on your device. Inner Thought uses AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption and keeps its encryption key in iOS Keychain.

Large recordings and videos are encrypted in authenticated chunks. When you play, view, export, or share an item, the app may create a short-lived clear copy protected by iOS complete file protection. Those working copies are removed when the app leaves the foreground and during storage maintenance.
An in-progress recording must briefly exist as an iOS-protected working file while Apple’s audio system writes it. It is encrypted immediately when the thought is saved.

Microphone access is used only while you record or dictate. Inner Thought requires Apple’s on-device speech recognition for live transcription. You can disable transcription globally or for an individual voice thought.
Location is optional, can be changed per thought, and can be disabled in Settings. Inner Thought does not track you in the background.

The system photo picker lets you select particular items without giving Inner Thought broad access to your library. Camera access is used only when you open the camera. New media stays inside Inner Thought by default; a copy is added to Photos only when you choose that option.

Nothing is sent to Moving Truth. If you use Share, Save to Photos, email, or another export destination, you are choosing to give a decrypted copy to that destination. Its privacy practices then apply.
Inner Thought has no user account, in-app advertising, tracking SDK, or third-party analytics. Diagnostic logs are designed not to include thought text, transcripts, filenames, or coordinates.

Deleted thoughts remain in Recently Deleted for 30 days so you can recover them. Deleting forever—or expiration after 30 days—removes their database record and managed audio, photo, and video files. Device backups are governed by the backup choices and protections you configure with Apple.

Inner Thought does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children, because Moving Truth operates no account, analytics, advertising, or content-collection service for the app.
If Inner Thought’s data practices change, this page will be updated before the changed behavior is released. Material changes will be explained clearly rather than hidden in legal language.

There is one Inner Thought—not an accessible edition and a default edition. Access is part of whether the promise is true.
a feature is not complete when its controls have labels. It is complete when the whole task can be understood and finished using the access method a person relies on.
Designed around different ways of interacting

Inner Thought is built to support VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, hardware keyboards, Larger Text, Bold Text, Increase Contrast, Differentiate Without Color, Reduce Motion, and light and dark appearances.
Recording, playback, saving, errors, and location state are never communicated through colour, sound, motion, or haptics alone. Gestures are accelerators rather than the only available path.

Text uses Dynamic Type and layouts are designed to grow rather than hide essential actions. Spoken controls use localized names and values. Live transcription is optional, and a voice recording remains safe when speech recognition is unavailable.
Photos and videos include a place for a person-supplied description. Playback exposes elapsed and total time plus an adjustable progress control.

Reduce Motion provides a composed static experience. Important state uses text and shape as well as colour, and the interface responds to stronger contrast and colour-differentiation settings. Atmospheric movement pauses when it is not useful.

Automated checks cover enlarged text, deliberately expanded copy, Arabic right-to-left layout, every supported interface language, and primary navigation on iPhone and iPad. Physical-device testing then covers complete tasks with assistive technologies, recording, permissions, widgets, and Live Activities.

We publish an App Store accessibility label only after every common task included in Apple’s criteria has been verified for that device family. We would rather leave a claim unpublished than overstate what has been proven.
An accessibility failure is a product failure. If anything stands between you and capturing, finding, reading, hearing, editing, exporting, or deleting a thought, email

Allow microphone access in iPhone Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone. A new voice thought can begin automatically only when that option is enabled in Inner Thought Settings.

If playback is silent, check the iPhone volume, Control Center audio destination, and connected Bluetooth devices. Inner Thought asks iOS to play through the speaker when no other destination is selected.

Transcription is optional and uses Apple’s on-device recognition. Availability can depend on the selected language and whether its on-device speech model is installed. All recognized passages are accumulated with the thought; natural pauses should not erase earlier words.
You can keep voice with no transcript, dictate text without saving audio, or type directly. The global preference lives in Settings, and voice transcription can be changed for each capture.

Location is a single optional point, never a track. If it was omitted, you can add or update it later from the saved thought. Turn the default off in Settings or use the capture-screen control for one thought.
Photos and videos are stored privately inside Inner Thought by default. Use Save to Photos only when you want an additional copy in Apple Photos.

A deleted thought stays recoverable for 30 days in Settings > Recently Deleted. Delete Forever removes it immediately; after 30 days the app removes it automatically.

Accessibility failures are product failures. If VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, Larger Text, Reduce Motion, contrast, captions, or another access need is not working gracefully, please contact us and name the task you were trying to complete.
Include your iPhone or iPad model, iOS or iPadOS version, and what happened. Please do not send a private thought or recording unless you deliberately want us to see it.

For those curious about the work beneath the calm, this is how Inner Thought is made: with native Apple frameworks, clear boundaries, recoverable states, and care for the whole person using it.

Inner Thought is written in Swift and SwiftUI, using SwiftData, AVFoundation, Speech, MapKit, PhotosUI, WidgetKit, ActivityKit, App Intents, CryptoKit, and LocalAuthentication. Apple-native frameworks keep the app close to the platform, private by default, and light on dependencies.

The interface expresses state; focused controllers and services own recording, transcription, storage, playback, media, location, encryption, and system presentation. Shared coordinators connect those pieces without making a screen responsible for everything.

Audio is authoritative and its destination exists before capture begins. Pauses, interruptions, transcription failures, and storage errors are designed as recoverable states. A valid recording is never discarded because speech recognition failed.

Titles, transcripts, locations, custom tags, audio, photos, and videos are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key lives in the iOS Keychain; decrypted working files use platform file protection and are purged when the app leaves the foreground. There are no accounts, ads, trackers, or third-party analytics.

Semantic controls, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, keyboard access, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, and non-colour cues are considered across complete tasks. Accessibility is evaluated as a path someone can finish, not a count of modifiers.

Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines and accessibility principles guide us to put the person—not the feature—at the centre of each decision. Inner Thought considers people with visual, hearing, mobility, speech, and cognitive disabilities, along with temporary and situational limitations. Meaning never depends on colour, motion, sound, or gesture alone; enhancements remain optional; privacy and dignity are preserved. Automated evidence supports this work, and release claims wait for physical assistive-technology verification.

Every visible and spoken interface string lives in String Catalogs. Layouts are bidirectional, user-authored words keep their language, and dates, times, and numbers follow the active locale. Fourteen launch languages are built in; draft translations still require fluent human review before release.

Home and Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities, the Dynamic Island, and App Intents share a deliberately small command layer and capture coordinator. Private thought text stays out of system surfaces; only the state needed to control an active capture leaves the app interface.

Deterministic unit tests exercise persistence, encryption, recovery, media, mapping, and capture state. UI tests cover navigation, expanded text, and right-to-left layout. Automated checks support the work; physical iPhone and assistive-technology testing remain release gates.

Grace was not painted over function at the end. Progressive disclosure, semantic typography, stable layout space, restrained motion, and quiet materials let substantial capability remain calm and understandable.
The result is meant to feel simple because the complexity has been carried carefully underneath.
